analysis.executive_summary: Audit of developer.bigcommerce.com crawled 3,693 pages (97.71% coverage of 5,000 max scope). Documentation contains 306 confirmed broken internal links affecting user-facing content. API reference coverage is critically low at 20.24% despite 808 API pages detected. SEO/metadata issues affect 26.69% of pages. Only 5.44% of pages display freshness timestamps, severely limiting content lifecycle visibility.
strengths: High crawl coverage achieved at 97.71% within scope limits
808 API pages successfully detected with reliable detection methodology
Multi-project topology successfully mapped across developer portal
Trap URL detection prevented crawl pollution (243 URLs skipped)
risks: 306 confirmed broken internal links create poor user experience and erode trust
1,033 unverified links due to auth/rate-limit/server blocks represent unknown documentation quality exposure
API reference coverage at 20.24% indicates 79.76% of API surfaces lack usage documentation
26.69% SEO/GEO issue rate damages discoverability and search ranking
5.44% freshness coverage prevents users from assessing content currency and reliability
Example code reliability estimate of 66.67% suggests one-third of code samples may be broken or outdated
Overall confidence score of 63.16% indicates moderate audit certainty with verification gaps

prioritized_actions.action: Remediate all 306 confirmed broken internal links across documentation
Implement last-updated timestamps on all pages to achieve >90% freshness coverage
Expand API usage documentation to cover remaining 79.76% of API surfaces (target 808 pages)
Investigate and resolve 1,033 unverified links blocked by auth/rate-limits to confirm accessibility
Audit and fix SEO/metadata issues affecting 26.69% of pages to improve discoverability

limitations: External audit cannot verify content accuracy, technical correctness, or completeness of documentation substance
1,033 links blocked by authentication, rate-limiting, or server restrictions could not be verified; actual broken link count may be higher
Example code reliability estimate is based on automated detection; actual runtime validity requires environment-specific testing
Crawl limited to 5,000 pages maximum; 117 discovered pages beyond scope remain unaudited
Audit cannot assess documentation usability, clarity, or alignment with actual product behavior
